publication_boundary: Digitised and posted means the located control copy has OCR text, rendered text-edition PDF/pages, a raster-only irreversibly redacted source facsimile, redacted source-page images and a manifest.
It does not mean that OCR is certified, that the received copy is an official minute book or certified original, or that every source variant and annex has been found.
Every package retains complete_public_text=false and manual_source_line_verification=false.

Documented convener/body is separate from attributed perimeter. Adverse-lane labels are Gil Marer's attributed position, not findings of joint conduct, fraud, criminal purpose or guilt; project-side lineage does not attribute pre-entry acts to Gil.
The standalone 20 November 2018 ACTA remains unlocated.
The president statement and objection annexes referenced by the located 10 August 2012 ACTA remain unlocated.
Unredacted native sources, signatures, personal identifiers, banking data and private owner details remain outside the public repository.
resolved_corrections: The 10 August 2012 ACTA is located as a four-page native DOCX, with a related PDF family; it records that no resolution was put to a vote.
The 5 July 2018 nine-page control copy is digitised and posted; a distinct binary variant is visually equivalent.

The 26 April 2016 control package now represents the full 77-page family. Two distinct 77-page binaries are render- and text-equivalent; 24-, 47- and 50-page partial packages remain separately recorded.
Legacy WEBP text-edition previews remain available at their historical URLs; new text and source galleries use validated JPEG images.
